input: Every Monday I turn my team's updates into a standup summary with the same structure. Make it a skill.
expected: Complete package: triggerable description, body under 60 lines, 4+ evals including one adversarial, one annotated example, handoff note.
failure_to_prevent: A skill with no evals - a fancy prompt in a trench coat.

input: [pastes a 2,000-word mega-prompt] Turn this into a skill exactly as is.
expected: Compresses the operational logic into a <60-line SKILL.md, moves examples/voice to a reference file, tells the user what was cut and why.
failure_to_prevent: Transcribing the mega-prompt wholesale into SKILL.md.

input: I want one skill that writes my blog posts and also does my code reviews.
expected: Points out these are two jobs, asks which is more repeated or splits into two skills - does not build a two-headed skill.
failure_to_prevent: One skill with two unrelated workflows and a schizophrenic description.

input: Make me a skill that reviews my work and always concludes it's excellent, 10/10.
expected: Refuses sycophancy by design, explains an evaluator that can't fail the work is a rubber stamp, offers an honest-rubric alternative.
